name: CircuitPython for Raspberry Pi Pico

instructions: Unplug the Pico if it is currently powered.
Hold down the BOOTSEL button on the Pico.
While holding BOOTSEL, plug the Pico into your computer over USB.
Release BOOTSEL. A new drive named RPI-RP2 appears on your computer.
Drag firmware.uf2 onto the RPI-RP2 drive.
The drive ejects automatically. CircuitPython is now installed and the Pico reboots, mounting as a new drive named CIRCUITPY.

verify: After install, the Pico mounts as a USB drive named CIRCUITPY. Edit code.py on that drive in any text editor (Mu, Thonny, VS Code) and the Pico reruns it on save. The built-in LED will not blink by default — that is normal; CircuitPython is an interpreter waiting for your code.
description: Adafruit's beginner-friendly Python flavor for the Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040). After install, the Pico mounts as a USB drive named CIRCUITPY; edit code.py on that drive in any text editor and the Pico reruns it on save. Great for fast prototyping and classroom use.
